approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: The wire format and the root protocol, release and godot specs do not change. The Python agent module spec (py/specs/agent) is corrected in place, as #64 did, so parse_room_text and mentions mode name the Raven frame; hi AGENT-* and the agent requirements are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: parse_room_text reads a Raven room frame (U+001E, RAVEN:ROOM:1, a newline, then JSON with text, mentions, optional string replyTo and optional photo) exactly as Raven's decodeRoomContent accepts it: the visible text becomes the message text, a replyTo transaction id becomes reply_to, and each mention's address is kept; any frame Raven would show as plain text (not JSON, not an object, text not a string, mentions not an array or over 100, a replyTo that is not a string reference, a mention with a bad address, non-integer, overlapping, too-short or out-of-range UTF-16 offsets, or a span not starting with @) stays plain text, unchanged. Plain text and section 9.1 and 9.2 JSON read as before. In commands mode a declared /command inside a frame is answered (reply around /ping, reply around /echo hello world, mention frame /echo @account hello, mention plus reply); in mentions mode a frame replying to one of the bot's own messages, or binding a mention to the bot's address, counts as mentioning it, and a frame naming another message or address does not. Regression tests for each row of issue #65's table fail before the fix and pass after, the Python suite and ruff pass, and frames built by Raven's own encodeRoomContent parse as expected. No wire, hi or requirement change; the bot's own replies stay plain text.
